test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper sells pulses at Rs. 100 per kg that he purchased for Rs. 80 per kg. While selling, he cheats and gives 800 g instead of 1 kg. What is his actual profit?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) of 1 kg of pulses = Rs. 100

Cost price (CP) of 1 kg of pulses = Rs. 80

Shopkeeper gives only 800 g instead of 1 kg.

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP - Effective CP

Effective CP for 800 g = CP × (800 / 1000)

Profit percentage = (Profit / Effective CP) × 100
